summary: The words the records map is written in (ADR-015 amendment 8). A place names one kind, one writer and one lifecycle from here; a new word is a new row, never an edit to a schema or an interpreter.

kinds.summary: A verbatim copy of one published kit release. The host runs it and never edits it; a change here is a change of release, not of content.
Which release a host was given and the digests that prove the copy is that release. Read to verify, never to learn.
A measurement of the host as it was found, stamped with the moment it was taken. True of that moment only.
The host's own answers: what this project is and which capabilities it enables. Stated, not measured.
Who is on the team: which roles are filled, by what, for which work.
What one role is: the archetype it composes and the host's delta over it.
Binding doctrine this host adds over the kit's: laws a gate or a reviewer may hold work to.
What one role learned and keeps for itself: corrections, validated approaches, its own open threads.
Curated facts more than one role must read the same way. The coordination plane, not a notebook.
A surface derived from declarations. It carries no truth of its own: delete it and it comes back byte-identical.
What a run observably did: receipts and dispositions written as it happened. Evidence, never testimony.
Accumulating measurements of cost and usage, one row per event, read in aggregate.
Facts already verified for a dispatch, each with the instrument and the moment of its reading, so the receiver builds on them instead of re-deriving them.
The live state an enforcement hook keeps between calls: counters, open holds, what it has already refused.
The step-by-step record of one mutating operation: what was intended and what was done, so an interrupted operation is recoverable and never reads as success.
The mark that one writer holds the host. Its presence is the fact; it carries nothing else.
Machine-run pipelines: what runs on which event, and which gates it holds a change to.
Why the work exists and what outcome it serves: vision, goals, the owner's standing requirements.
A binding choice with its context, the alternatives rejected and its consequences. Authoritative once accepted.
Descriptive, current facts about the system -- registers, ledgers, drawings -- consulted, not followed.
How to do one task, step by step, for a reader who already knows what they want.
Where the work stands right now and the next move: the one page a resuming session reads first.
The ordered set of work in flight and next, one line per card.
One unit of work: its outcome, its state, and the artifact each state produces.
Reports produced while doing work -- audits, probes, measurements -- that support a card or a decision and hold no authority of their own.
A record no longer current, kept for its history. Dead by location: nothing here binds.

writers.summary: The upstream kit, through a release. No host hand writes here; a host that disagrees changes release.
A kit command that mutates the host (init, lock, upgrade), under the host hold and through its plan.
The render verb, and nothing else. A hand edit here is a defect that the next render erases.
An observer or hook, recording what happened as it happened. No agent writes here by hand.
The accountable human. Agents may draft; the write that makes it true is the owner's.
Whoever the host's governance lets accept a decision -- drafted by any role, accepted on record.
The session that dispatches work and holds the position: one writer, so the position cannot fork.
The one role the place belongs to. Every other role reads, if it reads at all.
Whoever promotes knowledge into a shared place: a row enters by curation, never by a passing write.
The agent executing the card that produces the artifact, within that card's declared write set.
The act that retires a record: content arrives here only by transfer from its living place, never by authoring.

lifecycles.summary: Replaced whole when the host takes another release; the previous copy is not retained here -- its release is its archive.
Destroyed and recreated at will from its declarations; never backed up, never migrated, never hand-kept.
Only the latest state is kept; each write replaces the last, and the moment it was taken travels with it so staleness is visible.
Amended in place by its writer for as long as it is true; version control is its history.
Never edited once accepted; superseded only by a new record that names it, and kept forever.
Kept while it earns its place; reviewed, promoted or pruned by curation, never silently grown.
Appended while it is recent, kept for a declared retention window, then rotated out whole.
Exists for one operation: made when it starts, cleared when it ends; its survival past the end is itself the signal of an interruption.
Active while its work is open; when the work closes it is transferred to the archive, never deleted.
Terminal. Frozen as it was transferred; read for history, never amended, never binding.
